integrity: The universal conclusion rests on a proof using Kummer carries and factorial-unit prime-power blocks; finite checks are corroborative, and historical-priority limits are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient primitive-root hypothesis only; no claim of necessity, unconditional infinitude of qualifying primes, or index frequencies.
title: Catalan residues fill every \(p\)-adic ring when \(2\) is a primitive root
